name: Kyouso
source:
The Founder and leader of the Shuten Order, a religious nation that wishes for the end of humanity. Beloved by the citizens of Shuten, but only the 5 Ministers have a close relationship with the Founder. Was murdered on National Foundation Day, but the Ministers have hidden the crime from the public.

[spoiler]The Founder was secretly a combat hive-mind droid with multiple spare bodies, created by humans for war. She was hacked by human-made [url=/c153024]spyware[/url] [url=/c153021]programs[/url], manipulating her memories and personality, creating "[url=/c153020]Shimobe Rei[/url]". Despite this, a conscious part of the Founder's personality survived in Rei's body until she sacrificed herself for Rei.[/spoiler]
